blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A new identification system for persons with disabilities (PWDs) will use a centralized database and QR code verification to help prevent fake and duplicate IDs and make it easier for qualified cardholders to claim benefits, the National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) said. The Unified Persons with Disabilities ID System (UPWDIS) introduces a standardized ID with a unique alphanumeric number and QR code that establishments can scan to verify a cardholder’s identity through the national database. The NCDA said the system is designed to make verification more secure and address difficulties PWDs encounter when claiming their legally mandated […]...
